name: ENGL 3635
title: Law and Literature
description: The study of the law and legal concepts through the reading of literature as well as the application of techniques of literary study to legal questions and texts.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to sophomores or higher. May not be taken for credit after passing ENGL 3621 Literature and Other Disciplines when taught as Law and Literature.
